name: apiKey
label: API key
help: A Workspace API key (`nf_...`) from Narriflow under Settings, then Developer access. The Workspace needs an active Pro or Business plan.

name: baseUrl
label: Narriflow URL
help: Required. Enter your public HTTPS API origin, with no trailing slash or /api/v1 path. For local testing, explicitly enter http://localhost:4000. The cutover ticket assigns the final API hostname.
